Because every ROAM case is built to order, production typically takes 4–6 business days in our Vidalia, Georgia workshop.
Once assembled, standard free U.S. ground shipping takes an additional 4–6 business days for delivery (7–10 business days total from order to door).
If you need your case sooner, we also offer Expedited (2–5 business days, $100 per item) and Guaranteed (1–4 business days, $150 per item) shipping options at checkout.
